localize.text: A weapon that was never completed, still holding on to the desire to be finished.
Deals Pale damage. While wearing the Crown of the Unfinished, the weapon answers the unfinished desire.
A skin that mimics the wearer's outline, still waiting for its true shape.
An unfinished crown that still remembers what it was meant to become. Max HP +10, Max SP +10, Work Speed +10, Movement Speed +10, Attack Speed +10.
